findings.reason: The evidence confirms the change and KPI impact, but does not prove the specific mechanism (admission control/RRC timers) caused the drops.
T1 and T9 both explicitly state the onset of RRC success drop and drop rate spike at 2026-09-22 02:15 for S-TUN-013.
CHG-2026-0056 explicitly states the parameter tuning change was applied to AGG-TUN-01 at 2026-09-22 02:14.
T5 explicitly reports no maintenance windows scheduled on the listed nodes and ancestors during the specified time window.
T10 explicitly reports no external events for region TUN between 2026-09-21 18:00 and 2026-09-22 06:00.
CHG-2026-0057 states the rollback occurred at 2026-09-22 07:32 after KPI regression escalated by NOC.
